Our Process

Our step-by-step guide outlined below is designed to ensure your remodel goes off without a hitch!
01.
In-Home Meet & Greet
We will schedule an appointment to visit your home and take measurements and photos of your existing space.
02.
Design Meeting in Showroom
Meet with our designer and lead contractor in our Anaheim showroom and tour our factory. We will discuss your goals and desires for your remodel and our designer will begin to discuss space planning and design ideas.
03.
Estimate and Contract
We will provide you with a contract specific to your scope of work that outlines the services included and associated costs.
04.
Space Planning & Design
We’ll schedule a walkthrough of your space and work together to finalize the design. We will guide you through space planning and material selection. A detailed 3D rendering is provided for approval.
05.
Production & Install
Your custom cabinetry goes into production! A project manager is assigned to lead you through the whole process from demo to completion.
06.
Welcome Home!
Enjoy your new space from the enhanced aesthetic to the improved functionality with your friends and family.
